   3 │ ## What happens now
   4 │ Users can only use a fixed set of emoji codes that are built into the library. When someone tries to use an emoji code that is not in the predefined list, it does not work and shows an error instead.
   5 │ 
   6 │ ## What should happen

   8 │ 
   9 │ ## About this project
  10 │ This project is a Python library for rich text and beautiful formatting in the terminal. It provides features like colored text, tables, progress bars, and emoji support to make command-line applications more visually appealing and user-friendly.

  13 │ People need to use special or custom emoji that are not included in the standard set. Without this, they cannot represent their brand, special symbols, or unique icons in terminal output.
